resources.string: No model for %1$s → %2$s. Tap to set up
Cloud LLM is not set up. Tap to add an API key
Google ML Kit — smaller, supports many languages
Local LLM — a GGUF model running on this phone
Cloud LLM — your own API key, sends text to the provider
ML Kit and Local LLM run entirely on this device. Local LLM supports only English and French and uses substantially more memory. Cloud LLM sends the text you translate to the provider you choose.

With this engine, the text you translate leaves this phone. Each time you tap the translate key, that text is sent to the provider below with your API key, and the provider\'s own privacy terms apply. Nothing is sent while you type: live preview is off for this engine. Translation stays blocked in password, email, URL, phone and number fields.
Saved key ending in %1$s. Leave empty to keep it
The key is encrypted with a key held in the Android Keystore and is never logged, shown or backed up in usable form.
Translate key opens a translation box

Type in a box above the keyboard and the translation appears in the app as you type; tap ✕ or the translate key to close it. Off: the translate key translates the whole field once. With Cloud LLM, the box text is sent each time you pause typing.
Not available with Cloud LLM: it would send unfinished drafts to the provider.

Point the keyboard at any GGUF on this phone, e.g. in Downloads. Nothing is copied: the file is read where it is, and you can add several and switch between them. Models with a chat template (Gemma, Qwen, Llama \"-it\" / instruct builds) translate every language and follow Casual / Polite. Models without one get the raw EN:/FR: prompt of the fine-tuned English ↔ French model. Nothing is ever uploaded.
no chat template, English ↔ French prompt
Removed from the list. The file itself was not deleted.
Each language is roughly %1$d MB. That is the figure Google publishes, not a measurement: ML Kit does not report actual size on disk.
Checking which models are on the device…
No models yet. Download the languages you type in, and English, since every model translates to and from English.
Show translation instead of word suggestions

As you type, the translation appears in the suggestion strip; tap it to replace your text. You lose word suggestions and autocorrect while it is showing, and it runs many more translations than the translate key does.

These apps ask keyboards not to learn from what you type. BiLanguageKeyboard never saves your text anywhere, so it honours that either way. Turn this off to also stop translating in those apps. Password, email, URL, phone and number fields stay blocked regardless.
The fake engine uppercases your text and prefixes the target language. Nothing is translated and no model is used.
Translation powered by Google ML Kit, running on this device.
